content: We need to find template that when applied retrosynthetically (i.e., reverse of forward) reproduces Peterson reaction: forward: beta-hydroxy silane -> alkene + SiMe3 loss + carbonyl? Wait description: Peterson reaction: alpha-silyl carbanion adds to carbonyl forming beta-hydroxy silane, then elimination gives alkene, losing SiMe3 group and OH as silanol? Actually product is alkene, starting material is carbonyl + silyl carbanion. So retrosynthesis: target alkene (given) -> precursors: carbonyl (ketone) and trimethylsilyl carbanion (or silyl reagent). So functional groups broken: C-C double bond formed in forward, so broken in retro: C-C double bond broken. Also carbon-silicon bond broken, carbon-oxygen bond broken (beta-hydroxy silane intermediate). In forward, C-C double formed, Si-C broken, C-O broken. So in retro, we need to break C-C double bond, form Si-C and C-O bonds. The template likely has broken bonds: C-C double bond broken, formed: carbonyl (ketone) and trimethylsilyl group attached to carbon (Si-C). Also maybe OH? But description says ketones and trimethylsilyl groups are lost in forward, so they are formed in retro. So functional_groups_formed: ketones, trimethylsilyl. functional_groups_broken: C-C double bonds. That's what we used, but got no templates. Maybe need also specify bonds broken/formed? Could search with bonds broken: "C=C" etc. But we don't know format. Maybe need to search with functional_groups_broken: ["C-C double bonds"] and functional_groups_formed: ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"] but got none. Could try reverse: broken: ["ketones","trimethylsilyl"], formed: ["C-C double bonds"]? But forward description says those are lost, so broken in forward. So retro: they are formed. Our query is correct. Maybe need to include bonds broken/formed criteria. The Peterson reaction involves breaking a C-Si bond and C-O bond, forming C=C. So forward: bonds broken: C-Si, C-O; bonds formed: C=C. So retro: bonds broken: C=C; bonds formed: C-Si, C-O. Let's try search with bonds criteria.
